    blocks.append(cur)
    blks=[a[b[0]:b[-1]+1] for b in blocks]
    H=blks[0].shape[0]
    bb=None
    for dy in range(-H,H+1):
        for dx in range(-a.shape[1],a.shape[1]+1):
            inter=misA=misB=0
            for i in range(H):
                for j in range(blks[0].shape[1]):
                    i2,j2=i+dy,j+dx
                    if 0<=i2<blks[1].shape[0] and 0<=j2<blks[1].shape[1]:

            k=(inter,-(misA+misB))
            if bb is None or k>bb[0]: bb=(k,dy,dx)
    _,dy,dx=bb
